descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S19 Save Note as the physician feels it: tap to panels updated, 10 cycles (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home), with the AI's own time and model per call

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Save Note timing: panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles (a target, not pass/fail; a run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is investigated). … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given A fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; per cycle a fresh Hospital patient (age 72, Community-acquired pneumonia) or Nursing Home resident (Post-acute rehab after hip fracture); the local model

When Each cycle types the S01 (Hospital) or S02 (Nursing Home) text, taps Save Note and waits until 'Auto-updated:' (both modes' success message) or the summary-failed error is visible

Then Each cycle's time from the Save Note click to the visible result is recorded, with each AI call's model, fellBackFrom, durationMs and providerMs from diagnostics:list (parsing.parsePreRoundNotes, parsing.classifyAdmissionReason, parsing.extractTasks); the count at or under 15 s out of 10 and every cycle over 30 s are listed

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Recorded, not Pass/Fail (3.5 'timings are targets'): the runner writes status 'unknown' (to-allure shows needs-human) with the count ≤ 15 s of 10, the cycles > 30 s, and model, fellBackFrom and providerMs per call so a slow cycle can be told apart from a slow model. …

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S19

Save Note as the physician feels it: tap to panels updated, 10 cycles (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home), with the AI's own time and model per call

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-b: status record-only in newspec-b/results.json → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only)).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Chromium spec on the real local AI path (explicit filter): 5 Hospital + 5 NH cycles, fresh patient each, type S01/S02 text, click Save Note, time click → 'Auto-updated:' or the summary-failed error; read diagnostics:list as the physician for model, fellBackFrom, durationMs, providerMs per call. Record-only (status unknown): count ≤15 s of 10, cycles >30 s. — Timing is recorded, not judged (3.5 'targets'); ~3 model calls per cycle, 10 cycles as the oracle asks.

Detail:

Real local AI path (QA_LIVE_AI=1), 10 cycles on fresh charts: 10/10 within 15 s, none over 30 s, median 10.1 s. Hospital 10.1–15.0 s (parsePreRoundNotes ~6.6–7.1 s, then classifyAdmissionReason 2.2–3.6 s awaited, extractTasks ~2.4 s after); Nursing Home 7.0–7.9 s (parse ~6.5–6.8 s). Every call claude-haiku-4-5, no fellBackFrom, providerMs within a few ms of durationMs. Machine load average 25–60 during the run (other jobs, unrelated workloads).

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our chromium spec, not written yet): a fresh @roundai.test account and a fresh patient per cycle, made with the local admin key, and diagnostics read per call; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
